text:
Situation: Doxycycline hyclate 100 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 479 capsules (29.8 days), Corvale General holds 449 capsules (30.1 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules (18.7 days). The rule-identified best option is to buy from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include doxycycline hyclate as of 2026-10-21. Two manufacturers, Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., have posted discontinuations for doxycycline hyclate tablets on 2026-01-12 and 2026-07-30 respectively. A label for a Viona Pharmaceuticals Inc. product identifies Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603) as a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2023-03-24.

Our position: Current inventory provides roughly 30 days at East and General and 19 days at Lakeside. No FDA shortage listing exists for the capsule form. Discontinuations posted by Mylan and Teva apply to tablets. We should secure additional supply now while alternate sources remain available.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. as backup; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. as backup; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as backup; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as backup; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delay purchasing until a shortage is declared; switch dosage forms without clinician and committee review.
